settings.deadline_reference: scaled highest-frequency CPU chain length; independent of response variant

platform.temperature_slope_applies_to: each local node, both working and idle; CPU baseline is charged once per group

execution_rules.shared_deployment_scope: same application Stage across all scenarios and request copies
execution_rules.scenario_entry: independent; no inherited unfinished work or preceding-scenario temperature

x0_completion.scope: numerical row admission only; SAFE comes from the independent receipt

model_summary.objective: unweighted complete scene energy including leakage and idle tail
model_summary.coefficient_errors: outward interval rows; not solver arithmetic certification
model_summary.optimality_level: solver-reported only; external SAFE supplies a feasible upper bound

preprocessing.numeric_scope: fresh outward enclosure of retained physical choices; not old-matrix equivalence
